what: Added local XR alignment from one headset pose at the midpoint of a table edge and a switch to show only the selected station.
why: An operator can register a numbered station to a standard-height physical table while other participants continue working in the full fleet.
details: The Mac rejoined TheHumanTouch with --passthrough --table 0, selecting the original station (sticker 1). The local floor offset was corrected from +69.3 cm to zero. The eye-view filter excluded 850 primitives belonging to other stations and all 11 tabletop actors remained in the shared world. Physical edge alignment still needs a live headset pose and wearer check.
